svg.aria-label: Two processes run Ferry in front of one store. Normally key k is routed to P1. During a handover both P1 and P2 write k: P1's conditional write lands first, P2's is refused and retried after re-reading. Later a response is lost; the client retries on P1, which finds the input already stored and answers without writing it again.
svg.text: routing keeps one writer per key · the write keeps it correct when routing does not
1 · normal routing: k goes to P1
2 · handover: P1 and P2 both write k
3 · lost response: the client retries on P1
d is stored: answer, no write
the fence (write if the version is unchanged) stops a stale writer; deduplication by id makes retries safe
